{{PAGENAME}} is a NPC male professor who is talking with a Preparatory Student about dangers of taking too much classes. 

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Sundell:''' Prep courses lay the groundwork, so choose them wisely. History has proven that many times. If you don't believe me, I'll bet you a TARD-E Unit on it.

==Dialogue==
:'''Sundell:''' If you don't believe me, I'll bet you a TARD-E Unit on it. We had a student who ended up in the infirmary just three days into the Prep Program.
:'''Sundell:''' Tried to hop between senior-level lectures. Slammed straight into a trash can and broke two ribs.
:'''Sundell:''' ...Might even get held back a year for missing elective credit.
{{Dialogue End}}
